ऋजु, ऋजुक a. [अर्जयति गुणान्, अर्ज्-उ
Tv.] (जु or ज्वी f.) (compar. ऋजीयस्,
superl. ऋजिष्ठ)
1 Straight (fig. also);
उमां स पश्यन् ऋजुनैव चक्षुषा

.
--4 Favourable, beneficial,
good.
--Comp.
--आयत a. sitting or
being upright and stretched up
or distended;

.
--क्रतु a. acting righteously.
--गः
{1} one who is honest in his
dealings. {2} an arrow.
--गाथ a. Ved.
singing correctly.
--नीतिः f. Ved.
right conduct.
--मिताक्षरा N. of
a commentary on Yājñavalkya's
lawbook, generally called Mitākṣarā.
--रोहितं the straight red bow of
Indra.
--वनि a. granting
auspicious gifts.
